description: Activation-induced cytidine deaminase; deaminates C→U in immunoglobulin loci.
relation to immune response - secondary: Required for somatic hypermutation and class-switch recombination. Hallmark of germinal-centre (GC) B cells in lymph nodes, tonsil and spleen. Loss causes hyper-IgM syndrome type 2.

description: Rho GTPase-activating protein 10 (GRAF2); inactivates RhoA/Cdc42 and regulates actin remodelling.
relation to immune response - secondary: Indirect role: cytoskeletal control of lymphocyte migration and synapse formation. Appears in B-cell transcriptomic signatures; no defined SLO-specific function.

description: BAI1-associated protein 2-like 1 (IRTKS); I-BAR protein that bends membranes and bundles actin into protrusions.
relation to immune response - secondary: No established immune function. Recruited by pathogenic E. coli (Tir) for actin pedestals. Appears sporadically in lymphocyte scRNA signatures.

description: Cyclin D2; partners CDK4/6 for G1→S progression.
relation to immune response - secondary: Main D-type cyclin induced by BCR, CD40 and cytokine signalling in B and T cells. Supports antigen-driven proliferation in follicles; needed for B1 cell development.

description: Chemokine receptor for CCL19/CCL21.
relation to immune response - secondary: Central SLO-homing receptor: drives entry through high endothelial venules (HEV) and placement in the T zone/T–B border. Expressed by naive T and B cells, central-memory T cells and mature migratory DCs.

description: B-cell co-receptor (with CD21/CD81) that amplifies BCR signalling via PI3K.
relation to immune response - secondary: Pan-B-cell marker from pro-B to plasmablast (lost on most plasma cells). Lowers the activation threshold to antigen in follicles. CAR-T target.

description: Siglec-2; inhibitory B-cell co-receptor that binds α2,6-sialic acids and recruits SHP-1 through ITIMs.
relation to immune response - secondary: Dampens BCR signalling and sets tolerance. High on mature follicular B cells. Drug target (inotuzumab, CAR-T).

description: Heat-stable antigen; small GPI-anchored sialoglycoprotein. Ligand for Siglec-10 and P-selectin.
relation to immune response - secondary: High on transitional and memory B cells; low on GC B cells and plasma cells. CD24hi CD38hi marks transitional/IL-10-producing regulatory B cells. CD24-Siglec-10 dampens responses to DAMPs and acts as a 'don't eat me' signal to macrophages.

description: TNFRSF7; costimulatory receptor for CD70.
relation to immune response - secondary: Marks human memory B cells (very high on plasmablasts/plasma cells) and naive/early-memory T cells. Drives GC B-cell and plasma-cell differentiation and T-cell survival.

description: Main T-cell costimulatory receptor (signal 2) for CD80/CD86.
relation to immune response - secondary: Required for full naive T-cell priming in the T zone and for Tfh development, and therefore for GC formation. Counter-regulated by CTLA-4. Also on plasma cells.

description: Ectoenzyme with NAD+ glycohydrolase / ADP-ribosyl cyclase activity (produces cADPR); also an adhesion receptor for CD31.
relation to immune response - secondary: Marks human GC B cells (CD38+ IgD-) and, at very high levels, plasmablasts and plasma cells (CD38++), plus activated T and NK cells. With IgD and CD27 it defines B-cell maturation stages in tonsil and lymph node. Target of daratumumab in myeloma.

description: CAMPATH-1 antigen; small GPI-anchored glycoprotein on lymphocytes and monocytes.
relation to immune response - secondary: Highly expressed on mature lymphocytes. Soluble CD52 binds Siglec-10 and suppresses T-cell activation. Target of alemtuzumab, which depletes lymphocytes.

description: Leukocyte-restricted tetraspanin (TSPAN25) that organises membrane microdomains.
relation to immune response - secondary: Recruits PKCβ to support BCR signalling and B-cell activation. Stabilises L-selectin, so it is needed for efficient lymphocyte homing to lymph nodes.

description: Igα; signalling chain of the BCR complex (ITAM-bearing).
relation to immune response - secondary: Essential for BCR surface expression and signalling at all B-cell stages. Pan-B/plasma-cell marker.

description: Igβ; partner chain of CD79A in the BCR.
relation to immune response - secondary: Needed for BCR signalling. Mutated in ABC-DLBCL (chronic active BCR signalling). Target of polatuzumab vedotin.

description: Cyclin-dependent kinase 1; drives G2→M transition.
relation to immune response - secondary: Proliferation marker. High in GC dark-zone centroblasts and in clonally expanding T/B cells.

description: CDP-diacylglycerol synthase 2; key step in phosphatidylinositol resynthesis.
relation to immune response - secondary: Indirect: replenishes PI/PIP2 used by PLCγ downstream of antigen receptors. No specific SLO role described.

description: C-type lectin-like 1 (DCAL-1); type II transmembrane lectin-like protein.
relation to immune response - secondary: Expressed on B cells and dendritic cells. Acts as a T-cell costimulatory ligand that boosts IL-4 production. Locus linked to autoimmune disease (e.g. MS, T1D) in GWAS.

description: CD21; complement receptor 2. Binds C3d/iC3b on complement-tagged antigen and the EBV glycoprotein gp350. Forms the B-cell co-receptor with CD19 and CD81.
relation to immune response - secondary: Lowers the B-cell activation threshold for complement-coated antigen. Very high on FDCs, which use it to hold immune complexes for GC B-cell selection. High on mature naive and marginal-zone B cells; lost on plasma cells. Entry receptor for EBV. (Data symbol: CR2, not CD21.)

description: Cysteine-rich protein 3 (thymus LIM protein, TLP); LIM-domain zinc-finger protein.
relation to immune response - secondary: Expressed in thymus and lymphocytes. Proposed to regulate T-cell proliferation. Poorly characterised in SLO.

description: Derlin-3; ER-associated degradation (ERAD) component.
relation to immune response - secondary: Strongly induced by XBP1/UPR in antibody-secreting cells. Plasmablast/plasma-cell marker (medullary cords, GC-derived ASC).

description: CD23; low-affinity IgE receptor (C-type lectin).
relation to immune response - secondary: Marks naive/follicular and activated B cells; also on FDCs. Regulates IgE synthesis; soluble CD23 binds CD21. Marker of the follicular mantle and of CLL.

description: Frizzled-related protein (sFRP3); secreted Wnt antagonist.
relation to immune response - secondary: Indirect: modulates Wnt/β-catenin signalling, which acts through TCF7/LEF1 in lymphocytes. Found mainly in stromal/mesenchymal cells; no defined SLO role.

description: EBI2; receptor for oxysterol 7α,25-dihydroxycholesterol.
relation to immune response - secondary: Positions activated B cells at the outer/interfollicular follicle and is downregulated for GC entry. Guides DCs and Tfh precursors (splenic bridging channels). Key regulator of SLO microanatomy.

description: HIST1H3B (previous symbol); replication-dependent histone H3.1 from histone cluster 1 (6p22). Core nucleosome component; transcripts end in a stem-loop instead of a poly(A) tail.
relation to immune response - secondary: S-phase/proliferation marker: high in GC dark-zone centroblasts and cycling B/T cells (B_Cycling, B_GC_DZ). No specific immune function. K27M mutation drives diffuse midline glioma. (Older annotations, likely including this Visium/reference data, use HIST1H3B.)

description: IFN-induced protein with tetratricopeptide repeats 1; binds cap-0/5'-ppp viral RNA and blocks its translation.
relation to immune response - secondary: Classic interferon-stimulated gene (ISG); marks type I IFN-responding cells, e.g. during viral infection or near IFN-producing pDCs.

description: IFIT family member that forms complexes with IFIT1/IFIT2 and links to MAVS–TBK1 signalling.
relation to immune response - secondary: ISG; amplifies antiviral signalling. Part of the IFN-response signature in lymphoid tissue.

description: Immunoglobulin heavy constant δ (IgD).
relation to immune response - secondary: Co-expressed with IgM on mature naive B cells by alternative splicing. Naive/follicular-mantle B marker, lost after GC entry. IgD class switching occurs in tonsil/upper airway.

description: Immunoglobulin heavy constant γ2 (IgG2).
relation to immune response - secondary: Class-switched isotype dominating responses to bacterial capsular polysaccharides (often T-independent, linked to the splenic marginal zone). Weak FcγR/complement activation.

description: IgG constant-region pseudogene in the IGH locus (non-functional).
relation to immune response - secondary: Transcribed in class-switched B and plasma cells (germline/read-through transcription). Mostly a marker of switched cells and of multi-mapping IGHG reads in scRNA.

description: Immunoglobulin heavy constant μ (IgM).
relation to immune response - secondary: First isotype expressed: part of the naive B-cell BCR and secreted as pentameric IgM early in responses. High in naive, marginal-zone and B1 cells.

description: IL-4 receptor alpha (CD124). Pairs with the common gamma chain (type I receptor, IL-4) or IL-13Ralpha1 (type II, IL-4/IL-13) and signals through JAK1-STAT6.
relation to immune response - secondary: Receives IL-4 from Tfh cells in GCs: drives B-cell survival, proliferation, class switching to IgG1/IgE and induction of CD23 (FCER2). High on naive B cells, with FCER2. Pairs with the IL4->IL4R signal found in the GC niche (region 12). Target of dupilumab.

description: Lymphoid enhancer-binding factor 1; HMG-box transcription factor and Wnt/β-catenin effector.
relation to immune response - secondary: Works with TCF7 in T-cell development and naive T-cell identity. Promotes Tfh differentiation (via BCL6). Expressed in pro-B cells; aberrantly expressed in CLL.

description: ILT7; activating LILR receptor coupled to FcRγ, specific to plasmacytoid DCs.
relation to immune response - secondary: pDC marker (pDCs sit in the T zone/HEV area). Binding to BST2 restrains IFN-α production.

description: CD20; tetraspan membrane protein that supports BCR-associated Ca²⁺ flux.
relation to immune response - secondary: Pan-mature-B-cell marker (absent on plasma cells) labelling follicles. Target of rituximab and related antibodies.

description: Myeloid-associated differentiation marker; MARVEL-domain membrane protein organising ordered membrane domains.
relation to immune response - secondary: Regulates RhoA, cell spreading, migration and endothelial permeability. Broadly expressed in leukocytes; no specific SLO role.

description: Paired box 5 (BSAP); master transcription factor for B-cell identity.
relation to immune response - secondary: Activates B-cell genes (CD19, CD79A, BLNK) and represses other lineages and the plasma-cell programme. Repressed by BLIMP1 during plasma-cell differentiation.

description: Ribonucleotide reductase regulatory subunit M2; makes dNTPs in S phase.
relation to immune response - secondary: S-phase/proliferation marker. High in GC dark-zone B cells and expanding lymphocytes. Hydroxyurea target.

description: L-selectin (CD62L); lectin that mediates tethering/rolling on PNAd at HEVs.
relation to immune response - secondary: Required for naive/central-memory lymphocyte entry into lymph nodes. Shed by ADAM17 after activation.

description: SH3 domain and tetratricopeptide repeats 1; poorly characterised adaptor-like protein.
relation to immune response - secondary: Enriched in B cells in expression atlases. No defined mechanistic role in immunity.

description: GLUT5; facilitative fructose transporter.
relation to immune response - secondary: Indirect: fructose uptake can reprogram monocytes/macrophages towards inflammatory responses. Highly expressed in microglia; no specific SLO role.

description: TCF-1; HMG-box transcription factor and Wnt effector.
relation to immune response - secondary: Essential for T-cell commitment and for naive/memory and stem-like (progenitor-exhausted) CD8 T cells. Drives Tfh differentiation and GC help. Also in ILCs.

description: T-cell leukemia/lymphoma 1A; co-activator of AKT.
relation to immune response - secondary: High in naive B cells and pDCs; downregulated in GC and memory B cells. Oncogene in T-PLL (inv14) and CLL.

description: TACI; receptor for BAFF and APRIL.
relation to immune response - secondary: Drives T-independent antibody responses, class switching and plasma-cell differentiation. Limits B-cell expansion. On marginal-zone/memory B and plasma cells. Mutations linked to CVID.

description: Ubiquitin-specific peptidase 53; deubiquitinase linked to tight junctions.
relation to immune response - secondary: No established immune role. Mutations cause cholestasis and hearing loss. Appears in some lymphocyte signatures only.
